translations.source_sense_description: door schrik of angst terug gaan

glosses: A starting or falling back; a rebound; a shrinking.

examples.text: the recoil of nature, or of the blood

glosses: The state or condition of having recoiled.

examples.text: The recoil from formalism is skepticism.

glosses: The energy transmitted back to the shooter from a firearm which has fired. Recoil is a function of the weight of the weapon, the weight of the projectile, and the speed at which it leaves the muzzle.
An escapement in which, after each beat, the scape-wheel recoils slightly.
To pull back, especially in disgust, horror or astonishment.

examples.text: He recoiled in disgust when he saw the mess.

glosses: To recoil before an opponent.

examples.text: that rude rout […] forced them, how ever strong and stout / They were, as well approv'd in many a doubt, / Backe to recule […]

glosses: Of a firearm: to quickly push back when fired.
To retire, withdraw.
